risks.risk: Console may not be fully functional (e.g., HDMI/USB/audio issues) even if it looks intact.
risks.proof: Short video of the PS4 booting to the home screen, then plugging in both controllers and showing they work; also show HDMI connected to a TV and at least one USB device recognized.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: not fully tested / possible port faults.

risks.risk: Overheating/thermal throttling or fan issues not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Video showing gameplay for 15–20 minutes (or a stress test) with no shutdowns, plus a quick check that the fan ramps normally (audible) and no error messages appear.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: possible overheating risk.

risks.risk: Game bundle may be overstated (only FIFA 24 is visible).
risks.proof: Clear photos of the discs/cases for Ghost of Tsushima, Spider-Man, and FIFA 26 (or a photo of the game list on the PS4 library if digital).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: only FIFA 24 included.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-original or have drift/charging faults.
risks.proof: Video showing both controllers pairing, working in menus, and charging (charging indicator) with no stick drift during a quick test.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: controllers may have issues.

risks.risk: Exact PS4 Slim variant/storage not confirmed; could affect value.
risks.proof: Photo of the label on the back/bottom showing CUH model number and storage capacity (HDD size).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: unknown variant/storage.

risks.risk: Receipt claim may be false; could indicate unclear ownership/region issues.
risks.proof: Photo of the UK receipt (with sensitive details blurred) and/or proof of purchase details.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: no valid receipt proof.

proof_requests: Photo of the PS4 label showing CUH model number and storage capacity.
Video: PS4 boots to home screen; both controllers connect and work.
Video: HDMI output on a TV + quick test of USB ports (e.g., controller charging/USB device).
Video: 15–20 minutes gameplay to confirm no overheating/shutdowns.
Photos of all claimed games (Ghost of Tsushima, Spider-Man, FIFA 26) showing discs/cases, or a photo of the PS4 library showing they’re installed.
response.reason: From photo 0, it’s a PS4 Slim with 2 controllers and FIFA 24 visible, but key value drivers (full functionality/ports, overheating, and the full game bundle) are not provable remotely. To price safely, you need boot + controller + port test proof and confirmation of the other games.
